items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Files Share Offering, Is The Pullback A Valuation Opportunity?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) has filed a shelf registration to offer 609,118 common shares, worth about US$139.6 million, tied to an employee stock ownership plan. That move puts fresh attention on dilution and compensation. Salesforce’s share price has slipped in the short term, with a 1-day move down 1.3% and a 7-day share price return down 8.65%, even though the 90-day share price return is up 18.43% from earlier levels.
